run_bench_ivf_fastscan: run the IVF fastscan benchmark script to compare PQ, LSQ, and RQ index recall and QPS on SIFT1M
eval_recall_function: evaluate a FAISS index recall at k=1 and return recall and queries per second
eval_and_plot_function: train a FAISS index, evaluate recall across nprobe values, and plot recall vs QPS
benchmark_ivf_pq_indices: benchmark IVF indices with product quantization fastscan variants on the SIFT1M dataset
benchmark_ivf_aq_indices: benchmark IVF indices with additive quantization LSQ and RQ fastscan variants on SIFT1M
